# RF Strategic Ltd.

> Business consulting and sales solutions for ambitious UK businesses.

RF Strategic partners with businesses to build sales strategy and operating
plans that get implemented, not just recommended. Services cover sales
strategy, business consulting, and revenue growth planning. Engagements
follow a four-stage process: assess, strategize, execute, grow.

Founded by Robert, RF Strategic works directly with the businesses it
advises rather than handing over recommendations and stepping away.
